title.narrative: Strengthening the Capacity and Effectiveness of Jordan Supreme Audit Institute

description.narrative: The development objective of the Project is to improve the efficiency, transparency, and accountability in the use of public funds, by building the capacity of the Audit Bureau to become a well functioning Supreme Audit Institute. Specifically, the Project will support the Audit Bureau in fulfilling its mandate, as the Supreme Audit Institute, in line with the standards endorsed by the International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions (INTOSAI). To pursue that objective, the grant will support: i) reviewing the existing legal and institutional framework, and practices, with a view to develop an institutional structure that would ensure effectiveness, professionalism and independence, ii) enhancing audit methodologies for specialized areas, including financial audit, performance audit, procurement audit, and IT audit that comply with international good practices and risk-based audit approach, iii) training of audit specialists of the Audit Bureau in general audit techniques, based on international practices, and specialized areas, including: financial audit, performance audit, procurement audit, and IT audit (specifically related to GFMIS) that would help provide the skills needed to audit government accounts and state-owned corporations; and iv) train-the-trainers models and training materials that will enhance the Audit Bureau training capacity in auditing at the local level and as well the regional level through its under construction Training Centre. The Grant will help the Audit Bureau to position itself as a well recognized training centre locally and regionally. The training Centre is expected to be inaugurated by the end of the year 2014.
